title: BC Coast DTM/DSM No-Color Stack
subtitle: DTM terrain plus DSM-DTM surface masks; synthetic texture, no orthophoto color

items.label: Godot render
items.note: Real Godot viewport capture of the 26.6 km terrain package.

items.label: Terrain texture
items.note: Procedural no-color texture driven by DTM elevation, hillshade, slope, roughness, wetness, and DSM-DTM surface height.

items.label: Surface height
items.note: DSM minus DTM, normalized to 45 m; this is the main vegetation/surface signal.

items.label: Forest surface mask
items.note: Canopy/surface-density mask derived from positive DSM-DTM height.

items.label: Rock slope mask
items.note: Slope and roughness-derived rock/cliff material mask.

items.label: Wet valley mask
items.note: Low-elevation, low-slope proxy for wet valleys and darker ground blends.
